# Universities of Wisconsin

> The Universities of Wisconsin System comprises 13 public universities serving 164,600+ students annually through diverse pathways including traditional, online, and competency-based degree programs.

UW System provides comprehensive resources for prospective and current students across all educational backgrounds—from first-year and transfer students to working adults and international learners. The system offers 1,500+ degree programs, 300+ online options, and supports workforce development through continuing education and professional training.

## Key Topics

- UW System (13 universities)
- Degree programs (1,500+)
- Online learning (300+ programs)
- Admissions pathways
- Credit transfer & articulation
- UW Flexible Option
- Competency-based learning
- Graduate programs (400+ master's, 150 doctoral)
- Continuing education
- International students
- Military & veteran services
- Dual enrollment
- Academic advising
- Workforce development

## Getting Started: Student Pathways

- [Find Your Pathway](https://www.wisconsin.edu/find-your-pathway): Student pathway discovery for first-year, transfer, and online learners
- [First-Year Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/first-year-student): Admissions resources for Wisconsin high school students
- [Transfer Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/transfer-student): Transfer process and Transferology credit articulation guide
- [Graduate Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/graduate-student): Graduate admissions for 400+ master's and 150 doctoral programs
- [Online Learner](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/online-learner): 300+ online degree programs via UW Flexible Option and Wisconsin Online
- [International Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/international-student): Visa support and admissions for international students
- [Veteran/Military-Connected Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/veteran-military-connected-student): Military benefits and veteran services across UW System

## Specialized Learning Pathways

- [UW Flexible Option](https://www.wisconsin.edu/uw-flexible-option): Competency-based online degree and certificate programs
- [Dual Enrollment Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/dual-enrollment-student): High school dual enrollment via Early College Credit Program
- [Continuing Education Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/continuing-education-student): Professional development and workforce training programs
- [Re-Enrolling Student](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/re-enrolling-student): Resources for returning students resuming UW degree programs

## Academic Programs & Exploration

- [Find Your Academic Program](https://www.wisconsin.edu/find-your-program): Search 1,500+ degree programs across UW universities
- [Explore Classes at Your UW](https://www.wisconsin.edu/explore-classes-at-your-uw): Class schedules and course catalog search by campus

## Support & Resources

- [Parent/Family Member](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/parent-family-member): Parent resources and family engagement tools for student support
- [High School Counselor](https://www.wisconsin.edu/path/high-school-counselor): Counselor resources and Go Wisconsin outreach program

## About UW System

- [Universities of Wisconsin](https://www.wisconsin.edu): Homepage for 13 public universities offering degrees and impact
- [About](https://www.wisconsin.edu/about): Overview of UW System serving 164,600+ students annually
- [Systemwide Initiatives](https://www.wisconsin.edu/about/system-wide): Systemwide initiatives including 360 Advising and Math Initiative
- [Our Impact](https://www.wisconsin.edu/all-in-wisconsin/our-impact): Impact metrics and Accountability Dashboard for UW System

## Optional: Policies & Administration

- [UW Policies](https://www.wisconsin.edu/uw-policies): Board of Regents policies and administrative procedures
